description: Calculate waxed thread cutting length for leathercraft saddle-stitching from seam length or hole count, leather thickness, and pricking iron pitch.

pitchMm.description: Stitch spacing / pricking iron pitch in mm (e.g. 2.7, 3.0, 3.38, 3.85, 4.0, 5.0).

leatherThicknessMm.description: Total stacked leather thickness in mm.

mode.description: "len" (seam length in cm) or "holes" (number of holes).

value.description: Seam length in cm (mode="len") or hole count (mode="holes").

tailAllowanceCm.description: Needle & knotting tail allowance per end in cm.

name: calculate_leather_thread
